test_spatial: native 1024x1024, no cropping or resizing; PNG quantization before metrics
feature_preprocessing: RGB uint8 /255; internal bilinear 299x299 align_corners=False then [-1,1]
grouping: Released HER2match slide splits; patient identities unavailable
selection: 252 HER2match test pairs;63 per slide score

fix_protocol.checkpoint_selection: Same original16 center512 validation images, highest EMA SSIM; expanded48 validation staining diagnostics at final selected checkpoint.
fix_protocol.sampling: 3x3 grid of native512 crops at offsets0,256,512; tissue>=20%; low<=1%,medium1-10%,high>10% DAB coverage; 3/2/3 slots per effective batch; uniform slide then tile then crop within bin; fallback low-tissue pool only if bin empty.
fix_protocol.loss: FM + 0.1*balanced stained/unstained absolute DAB error normalized by fixed0.1 DAB scale. Mean per image over nonempty tissue regions. Differentiable HED with auxiliary RGB clamp and straight-through nonnegative DAB projection; no velocity clamp.
fix_protocol.loss_weight_policy: Fixed a priori lambda0.1; no test tuning or weight search
